title: IFANCA® Is the Islamic Economy Award Recipient for Compliance and Standardization
note: Demo snapshot of public ifanca.org content, for a training session only. Not an official IFANCA dataset. Content may be out of date. Check ifanca.org for current information.

blocks.text: IFANCA congratulates the winners of the Islamic Economy Awards. The awards “celebrated established and emerging companies that have demonstrated significant business and social impact using the Islamic economic ethos, and have inspired a new generation of leaders.” The integrity and credibility of the Award was managed independently by Thomson Reuters, the world’s leading information provider; audited by Deloitte, the world’s largest privately-held professional services organization; and adjudicated by an esteemed Judges’ panel based on formal, established criteria. A panel of eleven judges selected the award winners by first narrowing the nominees to three finalists in each category and then selecting the winner from among the three finalists. Congratulations to the award winners:
Islamic Food and Nutrition Council of America
HE Dr. Ahmed Mohammed Ali Al Madani
